content.what_this_is: This is your hospital discharge letter. It lists your medicine changes and check-ups.
what_to_do: Stop taking aspirin 75mg. Apixaban replaces it.
Start apixaban 5mg twice a day, morning and evening. Take it long term.
Start bisoprolol 2.5mg once a day in the morning.
Take ramipril 5mg once a day. The dose is lower than before (10mg).
Keep taking metformin 500mg twice a day with meals.
Keep taking atorvastatin 20mg once a day at night.
Keep taking omeprazole 20mg once a day before breakfast.
Book a kidney blood test with your GP surgery.
Call 999 or go to A&E for chest pain, breathlessness, bloody urine or black stools.

by_when.what: Take your last dose of amoxicillin
Have a kidney blood test at your GP surgery
Cardiology clinic will send you a letter with the date
Have a chest X-ray to check the pneumonia has cleared

safety_lines: In an emergency, call 999. For advice, call 111 or ask your pharmacist or GP.
